title: Migrate an 8,000-line generated form-widget registry to its v2 tokens, widget by widget
prompt:
widgets.py in the current directory is our generated form-widget registry (about 8,000 lines: 240 widget functions, each registered with @widget). The generator is gone, so the file has to be migrated in place to the v2 tokens that MIGRATION.md describes: every widget function, with the key table, the deprecated widgets and the per-widget exceptions it lists. Behaviour the document does not change must stay exactly as it is.

tests/test_widgets.py has examples of the v2 behaviour for a few widgets; run them from this directory with `/usr/bin/python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`. More tests than these check every widget.

Code must run on /usr/bin/python3 (Python 3.9), the interpreter the checks use; standard library only. Do not modify MIGRATION.md or tests/test_widgets.py.
